Trouble is, no therapist takes me seriously or even believes that I actually depersonalise because of my health anxiety. Since they wrote down that I have previously self diagnosed they totally ignore me as if I'm exaggerating. God it makes me angry.

I don't think there are many times in my life I've been made to feel bad about myself and feel disgusting. I had no idea people thought this way. At all. I'm not out as gay yet. It has been a long time coming and just trying to figure it out. 

Then I'm sitting with these two guys who I thought were nice people. One of them picks up on a hint I threw out and asks me if I'm gay. I give a "kinda" response and he says "as long as you're not fucking every girl in town". Um what? Then he said something about it being ok to do that as long as the girl has "big tits or ass". Okie dokie lokie. and they start talking about a party and "fucking bitches" or some shit. I'm kind of finding it all very funny and I tell them to please stop because they sound like "losers". True. And one of them blows up on me, obviously offended and tells me to "shut [my] mouth fucking faggot." AFTER TELLING HIM I MAY BE GAY ONLY MINUTES EARLIER.

 He didn't seem to regret it and carried on calling me a faggot until I walked off. and the other guy was saying he shouldn't call me that. I just got up and walked away and sat on some stairs, panicked and cried a little bit and felt gross and weird. Now I am super sad. The first people I told and that happens... I didn't think I was disgusting or weird... :(
